g.text: Err_post and pose metrics by solver and NFE; 3M parameters, alpha = 1, seed 0
Validation set (200 poses x 1,000 samples, seed 0), not test. The sweep stops at 64 NFE; larger NFE were not run. Values from the committed fr3_5d_fmpe_s0 *_val result JSONs;
no sampling re-run. The grey band is the oracle Err_post on the test set (+4.2e-06) ± 5e-4, the oracle noise floor; its lower edge is below zero and is cut off by the log
axis. Higher success and lower violation are better. NFE is the value recorded in each file.
